HERO.TAGLINE: Ideas become code. Code becomes experience.

ABOUT.TITLE: About
ABOUT.HELLO_TEXT: I build digital solutions where design and functionality come together.
ABOUT.GROW_TEXT: Discovering new technologies, expanding my knowledge and taking on new challenges.
ABOUT.MORE_TEXT_1: After several years in laboratory medicine, I wanted to grow professionally and take a new path. While looking for something new, I discovered web development. The more I learned about it, the more fascinated I became by the possibility of bringing my own ideas to life with code.
ABOUT.MORE_TEXT_2: What may seem like two completely different fields actually have a lot in common for me: care, precision, patience and the persistence to keep looking for a solution until it works.
ABOUT.MORE_TEXT_3: At the same time, web development gives me something completely new: I can turn an idea into something unique myself. It is exactly this mix of logic, creativity and constant learning that fascinated me.

PROJECTS.TITLE: My
PROJECTS.JOIN_DESC: Task manager inspired by the Kanban system. Create, organize and move tasks via drag and drop.
PROJECTS.MEMORY_DESC: Memory game with selectable themes, players and board sizes.
PROJECTS.POLLO_DESC: A jump-and-run browser game: help Pepe collect coins and salsa and defeat the crazy hen.
